data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Cars tab, pick-up, same drop-off, dates, times, Search, filters, sort) with nearly all the right parameters, but it puts filtering and sorting after Search without specifying which filters, and it treats drop-off as "same as pick-up" even though dropoff_location is listed as a parameter, so a browser automation would be mostly but not fully specified.
